_schema.backs: the Part-G layer-angle tracking paragraph in Appendix A.4, and Table S1 of the supplementary materials
_schema.layout: {model: {prompt_set: {scramble_layer: int, layers: [int], D_rotation: {layer: degrees}, S_rotation: {layer: degrees}}}}
_schema.units: degrees; angle of the named subspace relative to its unperturbed orientation, at each post-intervention layer
_schema.peak_definition: the angle AT the intervention layer (the key equal to scramble_layer), not the maximum over layers
_schema.L_minus_2_definition: the penultimate layer, layers[-2]. The final layer is excluded because the LM-head projection inflates all residual perturbations uniformly.
_schema.aggregation_convention: mean over a prompt's scrambles first, then over prompts within model; the values here are already at model level. Cross-model figures in the paper are unweighted means over the 10 models.
_schema.caveat: Table S1 as published in the supplementary materials does not reproduce from this file or from any other artefact in the vault; its values run systematically below every recomputation. Appendix A.4 in Paper_1_v63 quotes the values in THIS file. See revision_documents/Job2_E2_L2_angles_findings.md.
